selection.label: Shown board
selection.hint: Whose archived columns are listed. Bind a tab strip and the two move together.

board.label: Board
board.hint: The board whose archived columns are listed.

groupBy.label: Group by
groupBy.hint: Write folder to split by the folder a note sits in, or the name of a property to split by its value.

shownAtFirst.label: Bars shown at first
shownAtFirst.hint: How many of the biggest groups get a bar before anything is pressed.

step.label: Bars added by a press
step.hint: How many more bars each press of Show more draws.

showMoreButton.label: Show more button
showMoreButton.hint: Whether a press may draw past the first bars. Without it the rest are summed into one line.

lines.label: Lines shown at first, and added by each press

maxKilobytes.label: Largest file that may be shown, in KB

tabs.label: Tabs
tabs.hint: Every tab is a record. A folder makes each a note; a typed list lives in this tile.

label.label: Label field
label.hint: Which field is written on a tab. Without it a note shows its own name.

value.label: Value field
value.hint: What a tab hands down, and what files a note under it. Without it the label stands in.

selection.label: Selected tab
selection.hint: Which tab is picked, as a box. Bind another widget and the two move together.

items.label: Items
items.hint: The records the feed draws, one after another, newest first when the source is sorted that way.

pageSize.label: Items per load
pageSize.hint: How many more are drawn each time the end of the feed comes into view.

groups.label: Filter by
groups.hint: The properties offered. Empty offers what the board names or the tasks carry.

openGroup.label: Open by default
openGroup.hint: Whose choices unfold on opening. Name none and it opens folded.

properties.label: Board properties
properties.hint: The properties this board names. Empty offers what the tasks carry.

chosen.label: Chosen filters
chosen.hint: What is ticked, as a box. Point a widget's Where at it and this narrows it.

pick.label: Which habit
pick.hint: One habit only. Nothing picked draws all of them.

entries.label: Lines
entries.hint: One line per point. Each carries its own icon and colour, and reads as markdown.

text.label: Text
text.hint: The line itself, as markdown: **bold**, `code`, a [[link]] and the rest all draw.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: The icon inside the disc, under the name the icon picker gives it — tick, close, alarm-clock. A name nothing answers to draws a dot.

tone.label: Colour
tone.hint: The colour behind the icon: neutral, accent, success, warning, error, info, note, standout or highlight. Any other word draws neutral.

rows.text: **A list — yes.** More columns visible, more rows in view.
**Prose — no.** Past ~75 characters the eye loses the next line.

numbered.label: Number the lines
numbered.hint: Off, every line shows its own icon. On, the discs count the lines instead — 1, 2, 3 — and keep their colours.

solid.label: Fill the discs
solid.hint: Off, a disc wears a pale wash of its colour. On, it is filled with the colour itself and the icon or number turns white.

selection.label: Shown board
selection.hint: Which board this draws. Bind a tab strip and the two move together.

board.label: Board
board.hint: The board this draws: its columns, their order and which of them are archived.

opened.label: Opened task
opened.hint: Which card is open, as a box. The board draws it full size itself.

rows.label: Rows
rows.hint: The records this list draws, one apiece. Whatever a row holds is handed to the widget in the slot whole.

handedAs.label: Handed as
handedAs.hint: The name of the prop the row arrives under. @default/task-card takes task, @flow/commit-row takes commit.

selection.label: Selected row
selection.hint: Which row is picked. A detail tile reading the same collection follows it.

filter.label: Filter
filter.hint: Only rows whose filtered field holds these words are listed. Bind a search field and the two move together.

filterField.label: Filtered field
filterField.hint: The field the filter is matched in.

pageSize.label: Rows per page
pageSize.hint: How many rows are read at first, and how many more each press of Show more reads.

heading.label: Heading
heading.hint: A line above the rows. Left empty, none is drawn.

pick.label: Which log
pick.hint: The log this number is about.

period.label: Days the rate looks back over

records.label: Records
records.hint: One note per reading. Each carries a date and an amount.

rising.label: good · bad
rising.hint: Whether a rise reads as good or as bad.

periods.label: Periods
periods.hint: Every window the card can read over.

days.label: Days
days.hint: A folder of habit notes, or a folder of day notes for a single habit.

pick.label: Which habit
pick.hint: The habit this grid writes into. Bind it to a habit list and the month follows what the list picks.

source.label: Source
source.hint: The markdown to draw, typed here or bound to a note. # titles the page, ## a region, ### a group; plain lines are paragraphs. Links and embeds work as in a note.

collapsible.label: Collapse long text
collapsible.hint: Off, all of it is drawn. On, long text is cut to the collapsed height with Show more under it.

collapsedHeight.label: Collapsed height, in pixels
collapsedHeight.hint: How much of long text shows before Show more is pressed.

step.label: Show more step, in pixels
step.hint: How much each press of Show more opens. 0 opens all of it at once.

records.label: Records
records.hint: The notes whose properties are counted.

shownAtFirst.label: Properties shown at first
shownAtFirst.hint: How many of the most used properties get a row before anything is pressed.

step.label: Properties added by a press
step.hint: How many more rows each press of Show more draws.

showMoreButton.label: Show more button
showMoreButton.hint: Whether a press may draw past the first rows. Without it the rest are named as a count.

value.label: Query
value.hint: What is typed. Bind another widget to it and it filters as you type.

heading.label: Heading
heading.hint: What this part of the screen is.

badgeTone.label: What the badge says it is
badgeTone.hint: The colour a badge wears is its meaning: a count is neutral, a problem is an error.

badge.label: Badge
badge.hint: A count or a state, beside the heading. It says something about the body, never a filter.

filling.label: What fills it
filling.hint: Placed: you put each widget in yourself. Per row: one widget is drawn again for every row of the data.

options.label: One widget per row of data

arrangement.label: How they stand
arrangement.hint: A column reads down with nothing under it. A row and a grid give each widget its own plate. Rows stand in one plate with a line between them.

options.label: Across the row, a plate each
A grid that wraps, a plate each

minWidthPx.label: Narrowest a cell may be
minWidthPx.hint: The grid fits as many across as this allows, then wraps.

items.label: Rows to draw
items.hint: Bind the folder whose notes this section draws. The widget in the slot draws one of them at a time.

pageSize.label: Rows drawn
pageSize.hint: How many rows are drawn before the rest are asked for.

options.label: Options
options.hint: Every choice is a record. Bind a view box and it offers the views it holds.

selection.label: Shown choice
selection.hint: Which choice is shown. Bind the view box's own selection and the two move together.

title.label: Habit name
title.hint: What is written beside the emoji. Type one here, or take it from another widget's value.

emoji.label: Emoji
emoji.hint: A Fluent emoji by name, such as smiling-face-with-halo. A name nobody drew leaves the row bare.

records.label: Records
records.hint: The notes the table draws, one row each. A value reading emoji:<name> or icon:<name> is drawn as that emoji or icon, with any words after it beside it.

columns.label: Columns
columns.hint: Which properties get a column, in the order they are listed. Left empty, every property the records carry gets one.

rowTitle.label: Row title property
rowTitle.hint: The property drawn in the bare first column that names each row. Left empty, the table has no such column.

yesNo.label: Yes and no
yesNo.hint: Whether a true or false value is drawn as Yes or No.

rowsAtFirst.label: Rows shown at first
rowsAtFirst.hint: How many records get a row before Show more is pressed. Each press draws that many again.

fadeEdges.label: Fade the scrolling edges
fadeEdges.hint: Whether an edge the table carries on past dissolves, so there is something to say it scrolls.

task.label: Task
task.hint: The task this card draws. Held in a board it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

text.label: Text
text.hint: The line itself. Left empty, the widget draws nothing at all.

tone.label: Tone
tone.hint: One of label, value or caption. It decides the weight and the ink, never the plate.

heading.label: Heading level
heading.hint: Zero draws a plain line. One, two or three draw the line as a heading of that level.

lines.label: Lines
lines.hint: How many lines the text may take before it is cut. Zero lets it run as long as it is.

cards.label: Cards
cards.hint: The things being ranked. A folder of notes, or a list typed into the tile.

tiers.label: Rows
tiers.hint: The rows, top to bottom. Each carries its own colour, and its name is what a card points at.

cardSize.label: Card size
cardSize.hint: How wide one card is, in pixels. Between 32 and 160; the rows reflow around it.

open.label: Open
open.hint: Whether the box this opens is open. A box names it as its trigger, and reads it.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: The icon drawn on the button, picked off the grid: the kit's own glyphs and all of Lucide.

label.label: Label
label.hint: What a screen reader says the button does.

options.label: Options
options.hint: Every section is a record. Bind a view box and it offers the views it holds.

selection.label: Open section
selection.hint: Which section is open. Bind the view box's own selection and the two move together.

selection.label: Shown view
selection.hint: Which held widget is drawn. Bind a switcher and the two move together.

options.label: Options
options.hint: Every option is a record. Bind a view group and it offers the views it holds.

selection.label: Picked option
selection.hint: Which option is picked. Bind the view group's own box and the two move together.

commit.label: Commit
commit.hint: The commit this row draws. Held in a tree it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

value.subject: feat(catalogue): let the agent see the whole catalogue instead of only what the vault happens to hold

files.label: Files
files.hint: One record per file the change touched. Bind a commit list beside this one and the two move together.

selection.label: Selected file
selection.hint: Which file is picked. A diff standing beside this list binds to it and follows every press.

heading.label: Heading
heading.hint: The words standing before the count. Left empty, only the count is drawn.

shownFiles.label: Files shown
shownFiles.hint: How many rows are read at once, and how many more each press adds.

file.label: File
file.hint: The file this row draws. Held in a list it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

flight.label: Flight
flight.hint: The work this row draws. Held in a list it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

commits.label: Commits
commits.hint: The commit records written for this branch, newest first. Only the sha and its parents are drawn.

branch.label: Branch
branch.hint: The name of the branch these commits are on. Left empty, no name is drawn.

shownCommits.label: Commits shown
shownCommits.hint: How many of the newest commits the graph spans.

flights.label: Flights
flights.hint: One record per piece of work in flight. The newest start is drawn first.

selection.label: Selected flight
selection.hint: Which row is picked. A detail tile that picks from the same list follows it.

pageSize.label: Rows per page
pageSize.hint: How many rows are read at once, and how many more each press adds.

entry.label: Entry
entry.hint: The line this draws. Inside a log it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

title.label: Title
title.hint: The one line a person reads first. Left empty, the notice says it has nothing to report.

body.label: Body
body.hint: The sentence under the title, for what the title could not hold.

icon.label: Icon
icon.hint: The glyph beside the text, picked off the grid. Left empty, no icon is drawn.

tone.label: Tone
tone.hint: One of neutral, info, success, warning or error. Neutral draws no background of its own.

action.label: Action
action.hint: What the button says. Left empty, the notice carries no button.

pressed.label: Pressed
pressed.hint: Whether the action has been pressed. A box names it as its trigger, or another tile reads it by ref.

questions.label: Questions
questions.hint: One record per question asked, each carrying the options offered, the answer chosen and the reason for it.

question.label: Question
question.hint: The question that was asked, in full.

options.label: Options
options.hint: Every option that was offered, as a list or separated by commas.

answer.label: Answer
answer.hint: The option that was chosen. An answer naming none of them is drawn beside them, not dropped.

rows.question: Where does the loading threshold live?
rows.reason: One number a person can find and change, instead of three settings nobody tunes.

rows.question: How many rows does a list hand over when nothing asked for a number?
rows.reason: Enough to fill a screen twice, few enough that a vault of a thousand notes cannot take the frame with it.

project.label: Project
project.hint: The project this card draws. Held in a grid it is handed down; standing alone it is the one bound here.

projects.label: Projects
projects.hint: One note per project. Bind the folder they live in.

selection.label: Selected project
selection.hint: The project the pressed card names. Bind a task list or a docs tree to it and they follow the press.

pageSize.label: Projects per load
pageSize.hint: How many cards are drawn before the rest are asked for.

asked.label: Question
asked.hint: The question, the options it offered, the answer that was chosen and the reason for it. Standing in a record it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

value.question: Where does the loading threshold live?
value.reason: One number a person can find and change, instead of three settings nobody tunes.

body.label: Report
body.hint: The prose of the report, typed here or bound to a note. Headings, lists and links work as they do in a note.

figures.label: Figures
figures.hint: One record per figure, each drawn by the widget in the figure slot.

testPlan.label: Test plan
testPlan.hint: One record per step: what to press, and what should happen when it is pressed.

fixes.label: What was fixed
fixes.hint: One record per fix, with the file it was made in.

measure.label: Reading width, in characters
measure.hint: How wide the prose is allowed to run. A figure ignores it and takes the whole tile.

stepsPerPage.label: Test steps per page
stepsPerPage.hint: How many steps of the test plan are drawn at once.

source.label: Figure
source.hint: The figure to draw: a caption, and either the name of an image this vault holds or a drawing written as markdown.

lines.label: Lines
lines.hint: The log this draws, newest first. Each row is one line: when it was written, what it says, how it went.

linesKept.label: Lines kept
linesKept.hint: How many of the newest lines are held on screen. Older ones stay in the source and are counted, not drawn.

following.label: Follow the newest line
following.hint: Whether the view sticks to the end. It lets go when the reader scrolls away and takes hold again on a press.

album.label: Album
album.hint: The album this cover draws. Held in a shelf it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

beside.label: Art beside the text
beside.hint: On, the art stands on the leading edge with the title and artist beside it rather than beneath.

albums.label: Albums
albums.hint: The records the shelf draws, one cell each.

pageSize.label: Albums per load
pageSize.hint: How many more are drawn each time the end of the shelf comes into view.

tracks.label: Tracks
tracks.hint: The queue. One note per track, in the order the bound folder is sorted.

playing.label: Playing
playing.hint: Which track is loaded. Bind a queue beside it and the two move together.

isPlaying.label: Playing state
isPlaying.hint: Whether the transport stands at play or at pause.

position.label: Position
position.hint: How far into the track the transport stands, in seconds.

volume.label: Volume
volume.hint: The level the transport is set to, from nothing to full.

isShuffled.label: Shuffle
isShuffled.hint: Whether the next track is the one after this or one drawn at random.

repeat.label: Repeat
repeat.hint: What the end of the queue does: stop, start again, or hold on this track.

tracks.label: Tracks
tracks.hint: The notes this list draws, one row each. Every field may be missing — a folder of loose recordings is the normal case.

selection.label: Selected track
selection.hint: Which track is picked. A player bound to this plays whatever the list picks.

playing.label: Playing track
playing.hint: Which track is playing now. A player writes it; the row it names wears an equaliser and a heavier title.

filter.label: Filter
filter.hint: Only tracks whose title holds these words are listed. Bind a search field and the two move together.

pageSize.label: Tracks per page
pageSize.hint: How many rows are read at first, and how many more each press of Show more reads.

track.label: Track
track.hint: The track this row draws. Held in a list it is handed down; standing alone it is the one typed here.

position.label: Place in the list
position.hint: The number drawn where the equaliser stands while the track is playing.

isPlaying.label: Playing
isPlaying.hint: Whether this is the track playing now. The row answers with an equaliser and a heavier title.
